 Cyclonic storm developing near Sri Lanka, but moving away : What to expect
 November 16, 2026 at
 8:27 AM
 A deep depression in the Bay of Bengal is likely to intensify into a cyclonic storm by Monday (16) evening and develop into a severe cyclonic storm by Tuesday (17), according to the Department of Meteorology.
 The system was located approximately 640 km northeast of Trincomalee as of 11:30 p.m. on Sunday and is expected to continue moving away from Sri Lanka.
 Meanwhile, the Meteorology Department said prevailing showers across Sri Lanka are expected to reduce from today.
 Several spells of showers are forecast in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, North-western and Southern provinces, as well as the Kandy and Nuwara Eliya districts.
 Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva Province and Ampara District after 2 p.m.
 Mainly dry weather is expected elsewhere, while misty conditions may prevail in many areas during the early morning.
 The public has been advised to take precautions against temporary strong winds and lightning during thundershowers. (Newswire)
